data: What is the exact WER (Word Error Rate) of CTCC with beam width of 128 in the 'TH-CS' experiment?

Looking at the graph, the blue line (CTCC) intersects the orange line (CTC) at approximately 13.2% WER when the beam width is set to 128. Therefore, the exact WER of CTCC with a beam width of 128 in the 'TH-CS' experiment is approximately 13.2%.
